name: granted
title: Granted
description: Open the AWS Console signed in with any profile through Granted's assume, with ranked search for profiles, regions and services.
author: adamkpn

commands.name: open-console
commands.title: Open AWS Console
commands.subtitle: Granted
commands.description: Pick an AWS profile, a region and a service, and open the console signed in through Granted's `assume -c`.

preferences.name: defaultRegion
preferences.title: Default Region
preferences.description: Region used when you don't pick one.

preferences.name: useProfileRegion
preferences.label: Prefer the Profile's Own Region
preferences.title: Profile Region
preferences.description: If a profile in your AWS config sets `region`, use it instead of the default region.

preferences.name: awsFolder
preferences.title: AWS Folder
preferences.description: Folder with your AWS `config` and `credentials` files. Leave empty for ~/.aws. AWS_CONFIG_FILE and AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE still take precedence.

preferences.name: includeAwsCliProfiles
preferences.label: Also Ask the AWS CLI
preferences.title: AWS CLI Profiles
preferences.description: Merge profiles from `aws configure list-profiles`. Only needed for profiles missing from the config files; it starts the AWS CLI on every open.

preferences.name: assumePath
preferences.title: Path to Assume
preferences.description: Absolute path to Granted's `assume`. Leave empty to search /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin and PATH.
